title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Flat tape, hot PCE capped upside. Industrials led on cheaper oil, healthcare bled on pharma, all eyes on Nvidia after the close. Traders sat on hands — breadth positive but conviction zero.

INDICES — VIX 15.2, below its 20-day MA of 15.4. IJH +0.63%, SOXX +0.26%, QQQ +0.09%, SPY +0.02%, IWM -0.10%, DIA -0.19%. Small vs large: large +0.09%, small +0.05%, large by 0.04pp. Gold -1.58% — worst cross-asset move. No SPY/QQQ flags vs 200-day.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio and QQQ vol_ratio both at 0.5x, well below average — volume exodus ahead of Nvidia. GLD at 0.9x and IJR at 0.8x gaining attention, but price down on GLD = mild distribution. Low-conviction tape overall.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLI Industrials +1.09%, XLK Technology +0.61%, XLE Energy +0.60%, XLU Utilities +0.46%, XLB Materials +0.17%, XLF Financials -0.09%, XLP Staples -0.29%, XLC Comms -0.50%, XLRE Real Estate -0.60%, XLY Discretionary -0.67%, XLV Healthcare -1.00%. Top industries: UNG +1.76%, CIBR +1.30%. Bottom: GDX -2.94%, WGMI -3.40%. Money into cyclicals (industrials) and out of defensives (healthcare, real estate) — label: 'broadening participation'.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR 0.85, neutral; skew +8.4% positive = put premium, mild fear. QQQ spot near GEX flip at 710.0, dealer hedging will amplify downside. VIX 15.2 below 20-day 15.4 = complacency, but MOVE 69.4 remains below its 20-day.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold -1.58% while oil +0.95% and dollar +0.29% — dollar strength pressuring precious metals despite easing oil, an unusual divergence. Silver -1.17% confirms.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 42.4 neutral. Movers: ANET +5.92% on pre-Nvidia chip momentum; INTU -3.24% with 3.0x vol spike = distribution; WPM -4.70%, AEM -4.49% on gold's drop. 20d momentum best: SOXX +10.84%; worst: XLU -3.12%. Watch XLV (-1.00%) — healthcare distribution ahead of drug-pricing news; ANET (+5.92%) — holding gains into NVDA print; GLD (-1.58%) — broke below its vol regime, watch $400 gamma flip.
